result.description:
Ashburton Aboriginal Corporation (AAC) is seeking a dedicated and community-focused Employment Consultant to support job seekers on their journey toward meaningful and sustainable employment.
In this role, you will provide comprehensive case management to individuals registered with Centrelink, working with people from a wide variety of cultural, social, and economic backgrounds. This includes supporting clients who may be socio-economically disadvantaged, long-term unemployed, or living with disability.
You will build strong, trusting relationships with participants, assess their needs, develop tailored employment plans, and guide them through barriers that may impact their job readiness. The role requires ongoing monitoring, documentation, coaching, and advocacy to ensure each client receives an individualized and culturally appropriate level of support.
Success in this position relies on excellent communication skills, genuine empathy, and strong administrative capabilities to maintain accurate records, manage appointments, and meet program requirements. As an Employment Consultant, you will play a vital role in empowering individuals to build confidence, develop skills, and achieve long-term employment outcomes.

result.description:
This is a locum doctor role for a Paediatrics Consultant at Port Macquarie in NSW.

### Role Info

The Port Macquarie Base Hospital paediatric service is supported by a dedicated team of junior medical officers, with 24-hour onsite JMO coverage available to assist the consultant at all times. The locum specialist will undertake daily ward rounds and provide on-call coverage across the full 24-hour period of each rostered day, with the expectation of re-attending the hospital as required for clinical reviews or emergencies. While there is no requirement to participate in outpatient clinics, the role provides exposure to a well-established regional paediatric service. The facility is a NSW Level 4 paediatric unit comprising a 15-bed Children’s Ward and is complemented by a NSW Level 3 neonatal service with 8 nursery beds, providing comprehensive inpatient care for paediatric and neonatal patients.



Daily Rate: $2500
